whyUs.heading: Why work with us
whyUs.text1: We combine accredited laboratory testing, field sampling expertise and community health practice to deliver environmental health and risk assessment services across Canada.
whyUs.text2: Our teams design monitoring programs and preventive controls that align with federal and provincial frameworks including the Guidelines for Canadian Drinking Water Quality, Canadian Environmental Quality Guidelines, Canadian Ambient Air Quality Standards, the Safe Food for Canadians Regulations, and provincial public health standards, so clients meet both scientific best practice and regulatory expectations.

finalCta.heading: Secure Your Environment Today
finalCta.text: Ensure your facilities meet scientific best practices and public health standards. Reach out to our consulting team for specialized assessments.
